Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper from Los Angeles, California, best known for his offbeat rap style, viral personality, and the breakout hit “Thotiana.”

Blueface rose to mainstream attention around 2018–2019, when “Thotiana” became a major viral hit. The song later received high-profile remixes featuring Cardi B and YG, helping establish him as one of the most recognizable new West Coast rappers of that era. He was also associated with Cash Money West and built a reputation for his distinctive delivery and internet-heavy approach to promoting music.

Outside of music, Blueface has remained a frequent subject of entertainment and social-media coverage because of his highly publicized relationships, family drama, legal issues, and controversial online moments. His personal life has often generated nearly as much attention as his music.

Musically, some of his best-known songs include “Thotiana,” “Bleed It,” “Daddy,” “Stop Cappin,” and “Respect My Cryppin.” He has also collaborated with artists including Cardi B, YG, Offset, The Game, Chris Brown, and Snoop Dogg.

Overall, Blueface is best known as a West Coast rapper who turned viral internet fame into a successful music career, with “Thotiana” remaining his signature record.
